## Problem

What does not work today, or what is harder than it should be?

## Proposed Behaviour

What should happen instead? Be specific about the observable result.

## Target

- [ ] v1 binary patch (`v1-binary-patch/`, patched `applewirelessmouse.sys` + LowerFilter)
- [ ] v2 KMDF rewrite (`v2-kmdf-driver/`, clean-room driver)
- [ ] Documentation or tooling only

## Hardware and OS Scope

- **Magic Mouse Model:** [Apple Magic Mouse v3 (2024), PID 0x0323 — this repo is v3-only]
- **Windows Version:** [e.g., Windows 10 build 19045 / Windows 11 23H2]
- **Applies to:** [all supported builds / only the build above]

## Alternatives Considered

What else did you try or reject, and why?

## Additional Context

Links, event logs, HID traces, or prior issues.

See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full contribution process.
